info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Accounts Receivable Management API
info.description: The Accounts Receivable Management API allows businesses to efficiently retrieve information related to their accounts receivable. It provides access to details about outstanding invoices, payment statuses, and customer account balances. This API is essential for financial teams and accounting software that need to track receivables and manage cash flow. Users can utilize this API to gain insights into their accounts receivable status and make informed financial decisions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about accounts receivable, helping you manage outstanding balances and maintain accurate financial records.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving accounts receivable data. This defines the structure of the request payload required for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the accounts receivable data.

GetAccountsReceivableRequest.description: Request body for retrieving accounts receivable operations.

items.description: A list of account items for accounts receivable.

sort.description: Information about how the items are sorted.

GetAccountsReceivableResponse_200.description: Response schema for the accounts receivable operation when accessed via GET. It includes a list of account items, pagination info, sorting details, and metadata.

customerId.description: Unique identifier for the customer associated with the account.

ledgerDate.description: The date associated with the ledger entry.

currency.description: The currency used for the ledger balance.

ledgerBalance.description: The balance amount in the account ledger.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the account item was last updated.

AccountItem.description: Represents an individual account item in the accounts receivable list.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

totalItems.description: The total number of items available.

Pagination.description: Pagination information for the list of items.

correlationId.description: Identifier for tracking the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The geographical region where the request was processed.

Metadata.description: Metadata information related to the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: The unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the runtime application handling the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer Authentication method. Tokens are passed in the HTTP Authorization header as a 'Bearer' token. JWT (JSON Web Token) is a compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred between two parties.
